adaptation.ATR14: Existing Indicators: arithmetic mean of 14 genuine valid trailing true ranges, includes just-completed breakout bar; continuous across days/sessions, no daily reset. Adjacent previous close only; otherwise H-L. All available 2023 history including outside entry windows warms ATR; no fabricated pre-2023 warmup.
adaptation.M1_non_equivalence: M5 adaptation, not equivalent to M1 opening/execution; historical max hold was 120 available M1 bars and no observed M1 at/after 17:00. This run uses 120 calendar minutes and an explicit exact-Open 17:00 cutoff.
adaptation.OR: Exactly valid completed starts 10:00/10:05/10:10, fixed and available at 10:15. No replacement bars.
adaptation.cost: C1 one dated tick per side, ledger deductions; no synthetic scenario-price alterations.
adaptation.entry: Retest completes -> one full following M5 completes -> next interval Open, only inside approved calendar and strictly before effective deadline. No future H/L/C/V for admission.
adaptation.exit: Earliest entry+120 calendar minutes, approved calendar window.end-5 minutes, or exact Open 17:00. At 17:00 use Open scalar only, no 17:00-17:05 OHLC exposure. Stop gap has precedence. No entry at deadline.
adaptation.retest: Exactly breakout.start+5 minutes in same intersection window; missing/invalid/outside consumes attempt and is diagnosed. Breakout cannot retest itself; first onset consumes one attempt per side/day regardless of execution.
adaptation.signal_windows: Inclusive M5 START labels; breakout and retest each wholly inside same R17 window intersected with approved calendar. Afternoon first permitted start 14:05 normally and 14:15 on March 13-20. Noon window last start 12:55, afternoon 16:50.
adaptation.stop: Midpoint=(OR_HIGH+OR_LOW)/2 rounded to nearest historical retest tick with ROUND_HALF_UP (positive half ties upward), then LONG midpoint-1 tick / SHORT midpoint+1 tick. Core validates adverse risk versus actual entry Open. No minimum Stop filter.
adaptation.target: Core target at 1.5 initial gross risk; outward entry-grid rounding (LONG ceiling / SHORT floor) as canonical execution.
adaptation.unknown: Unresolved same day blocked; next independent research day conditionally assumes FLAT, never proven broker FLAT; annual continuous economics null on incomplete data/UNKNOWN.

classification_policy.precedence: Incomplete coverage/outcomes => INCONCLUSIVE with separate conditional diagnosis; complete negative known expectancy => NO ECONOMIC BASELINE PASS; positive but insufficient sample => INCONCLUSIVE; complete positive stable unconcentrated sample satisfying all fixed criteria => ECONOMICALLY_PROMISING_BASELINE. No automatic Optimization.

contract: One historical candidate, one frozen M5 adaptation, common Backtester; no optimization or TradingSystemLab changes. 2024 WF / 2025+ TRUE OOS not read.

historical_selection.selection_bias: Historical winner among 72; not a confirmed robust strategy. Only archived research documents read; no historical 2026 market data accessed.
